incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 500s for /v1/embeddings (alert A-2026-3321). started ~1776543205 UTC. paging oncall.

sam_platform: seeing a big surge out of eu-west-1. routing logs show 'incompatible_api: request for embeddings routed to model without embed capability' in a lot of traces.

maya_oncall: oncall here — i'm looking. who changed embed alias pins recently?

leo_sre: pulling config. there was a config job yesterday that pinned alias `redwood.embed.v1` -> `redwood-chat-2b`. snippet i grabbed: 

```
route: /v1/embeddings
alias: redwood.embed.v1
pinned_model: redwood-chat-2b  # CHAT model, doesn't implement embeddings endpoint
fallback: auto
```

anya_ce: uhhh that explains the 500s. chat models don't implement the embeddings API, so the runtime returns 500 for those calls.

maya_oncall: customer impact? who's most affected?

sam_platform: query -> top customers by failed calls: LumaAnalytics (~6.5k fails), AcmeCorp (~3.2k), PixieMetrics (~2.1k). approx 11.8k failed embed requests in last 12m. mostly eu-west-1, some bleed to us-east due to cross-region routing.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T09:11 UTC: cfg-job #8310 applied by @ops-config -> pinned alias redwood.embed.v1 to redwood-chat-2b (change-id: cfg-8310)

maya_oncall: mitigation: unpin alias immediately and force routes to a validated embed model (text-embed-003). leo, can you apply override and purge caches?

leo_sre: applying manual override: 

PATCH /internal/route-overrides
{ "alias": "redwood.embed.v1", "model": "text-embed-003", "reason": "emergency-unpin-1776543330" }

leo_sre: override applied at 1776543345. initiating drain of pinned nodes. expect significant drop in errors within ~60s as edge entries refresh.

maya_oncall: @customer-support please notify impacted customers with retry guidance. mention ETA and suggest backoff/retry window.

customer-support: sending notices to LumaAnalytics, AcmeCorp, PixieMetrics now. using templated message and offering to help with retries.

sam_platform: metrics update: 5xx rate fell ~68% after override. traces show requests routing back to text-embed-003. still a tail due to edge TTLs (~3-5m) and some clients with sticky routing.

anya_ce: any sign we returned wrong data (e.g., chat tokens instead of vectors)? need to confirm no corrupted payloads were delivered.

leo_sre: checked payloads — failed requests returned 500 with body 'incompatible_variant: embeddings endpoint unsupported'. successful responses after override include plausible float vectors. no evidence of chat responses sneaking into embed outputs.

maya_oncall: root-cause notes for later: 
- cfg-8310 pinned embed alias to a chat model (mis-tagged change)
- deploy pipeline lacked capability validation for alias->model pins
- long edge cache TTL increased blast radius

infra-sre: created INFRA-7231: add deploy-time validation to ensure alias capability matches model (embed/chat/gen). tagging config and runtime teams.

leo_sre: edge cache purge command issued at 1776543450. propagation estimated complete in ~3m.

maya_oncall: handoff: i'm covering next 30m and will watch the error budget. @leo_sre monitor eu-west-1 errors; if 5xxs don't fall below 1% in 10m -> escalate pager.

leo_sre: ack. setting a temporary alert.

sam_platform: note: we should add a pre-deploy lint that rejects pins where model.capabilities doesn't include alias.required_capability. quick remediation ticket created CFG-VALID-177654.

customer-support: update sent: initial impact summary, ETA to recover (~8 min), recommended retry window, and invite to contact support for replays. no SLA credits offered yet pending final outage window.

maya_oncall: timeline/notes assigned to INC-2026-041. postmortem owners: @anya_ce and @leo_sre. collect traces and deploy logs.

leo_sre: 1776543775 - metrics back to baseline (<0.2% 5xx). closing immediate paging. followups: CFG-VALID-177654 and INFRA-7231.

maya_oncall: thanks everyone. keep adding evidence and timestamps to the incident doc. postmortem due EOD+2. closing thread when no regressions in 30m. :white_check_mark:
